title: Paradox Protocol | ECHO//100 Episode 77
description: Kavi attempts to intercept his own traumatic abduction, only to realize he is the architect of his own misery. Episode 77 of ECHO//100: The First Kavi. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: Kavi lunges for his younger self, but his fingers phase right through the boy’s glass shoulder.
scenes.caption: Ghostly touch failure
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, adult Kavi in red hoodie reaching for a terrified young boy in a glass bedroom.

scenes.text: The child screams as the void opens, a swirling vortex of static hungry for his fragile existence.
scenes.caption: The void opens
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, a swirling dark vortex appearing behind a young boy sitting on a glass bed.

scenes.text: Kavi screams, realizing his own frantic arrival at the Origin Point actually signaled the kidnapper to strike.
scenes.caption: Triggering the loop
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi standing in the doorway, his silhouette casting a shadow that triggers the vortex.

scenes.text: The timeline feeds on his failure, a closed circuit that demands a victim to sustain its reality.
scenes.caption: Self-sustaining trap
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, the glass bedroom cracking into geometric patterns, showing Kavi's reflection in every shard.

scenes.text: Null steps from the shadows, his glitching black-purple form crackling with the energy of a thousand timelines.
scenes.caption: Null emerges
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null with glowing red eyes stepping through a digital tear in the glass wall.

scenes.text: Null catches the boy, whispering that he stole him to hide him from the Architect’s total deletion.
scenes.caption: The truth revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null holding the young boy protectively while Kavi watches in total, stunned silence.

scenes.text: Null turns to Kavi, extending a hand to offer a heavy, vintage phone stained with deep static.
scenes.caption: The offered phone
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Null handing a dead, retro-style phone to adult Kavi in his signature red hoodie.

scenes.text: The dead phone suddenly sparks to life, its screen displaying a caller ID from the distant future.
scenes.caption: Incoming future call
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, close up on the phone screen glowing bright white, Kavi looking at it in terror.
